title: Template:Team/doc
wikitext:
Same as <nowiki>{{player}}</nowiki>, just other name.

==Example==
This code:
 <nowiki>{{team|Orkney Clan|flag=se}}</nowiki>
 <nowiki>{{team|Ihasnowikipage|flag=us|link=false}}</nowiki>

Returns this:
:{{team|Orkney Clan|flag=se}}
:{{team|Ihasnolink|flag=us|link=false}}
